title: Secrets and credentials
requirement: Keep sign-ins and credentials off the checkout and detect accidental secret exposure before publication.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Qualify openbao, or a comparable secret manager, only against a concrete multi-host or multi-operator secret-sharing need; broker credential handling stays a trading gate, not a foundation selection.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
